subject: Starnexa vendor intake & PO path — procurement readiness
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Morris <ellen.morris@starnexa.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@starnexa.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starnexa vendor intake & PO path — procurement readiness

Hi Ellen / Raj —

Great to speak this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement and onboarding timing: 

1) Decision criteria & timeline
- Primary goal: pilot Redwood inference on two production endpoints for 6 weeks (accuracy + latency validation).
- Target contract start: mid-Oct (we discussed 2026-10-15 as a soft target).

2) Procurement / vendor setup items you flagged
- SOC 2 report and data handling summary (we can provide a redacted copy).
- W-9 and vendor setup paperwork for your AP team.
- PO cadence: you asked about Net30 and whether we accept PO numbers — short answer: yes, Net30 acceptable; we need a PO for invoicing.

3) Internal owners (who we looped on this thread)
- Jasmine Liu (Customer Success) — will run pilot onboarding and tests.
- Kimberly Park (Finance/Legal) — will own commercial/W-9/SOW signoff.

4) Attachments I’m sharing now (see metadata):
- redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf (vendor packet with W-9, insurance, onboarding checklist)
- redwood_sow_starnexa_v1.docx (draft SOW for pilot)

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Connor: email procurement packet + draft SOW (today).
- Ellen: share procurement intake contact and any internal SLA/approval constraints; confirm if any additional security artifacts required beyond SOC2.
- Jasmine/Kimberly: weigh in on billing entity and standard payment terms.

If you prefer, I can route the packet to Michael Lee (procurement) directly once you share his contact.

Thanks — speak soon,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
Attachment: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf (3 pages, stub)

From: Ellen Morris <ellen.morris@starnexa.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@starnexa.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starnexa vendor intake & PO path — procurement readiness

Connor — thanks for the recap and for sending the packet. Couple of quick items from procurement side:

- Can you share your SOC 2 report (redacted copy is fine) and a short data-flow diagram? Our security team wants to understand where keys and logs live.
- Procurement contact is Michael Lee (michael.lee@starnexa.com). He handles vendor onboarding and PO acceptance. I’ve copied Raj who will coordinate internally.
- Payment terms: Net30 is our standard; we operate via PO numbers and occasional contract redlines (legal). If you can accept PO-based invoicing that’s preferred.

Michael will likely request the standard vendor intake form — I’m attaching the blank form so you can pre-fill anything helpful.

Thanks,
Ellen
Director, IT Procurement
Starnexa
Attachment: starnexa_procurement_form.pdf (fillable)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starnexa vendor intake & PO path — procurement readiness

Connor / Jasmine —

Quick notes from finance/legal after reviewing the packet and draft SOW: 

- SOC 2: we will provide the 2026 Type II redacted PDF (I recommend we redact control test details and provide a short two-paragraph summary of data flows). I’ll attach the link when we send the packet.
- W-9 & Insurance: included in the vendor packet you sent. Finance will need the billing entity + remit-to address and whether Starnexa requires a specific invoice header for PO matching.
- Payment terms: Net30 is OK; Finance prefers a default remittance to Redwood, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789). If Starnexa needs an alternate legal entity or subcontractor addendum, flag now.
- Vendor setup lead time: typical AP/vendor onboarding at larger enterprises is 7–14 business days after receipting paperwork plus PO issuance. If Starnexa needs the service to start earlier, we can discuss prepaid/short-term arrangements but for standard PO flow plan for two weeks.

Action items for us before we share externally:
- Connor: confirm billing entity details and preferred invoice header.
- Jasmine: prepare a high-level pilot onboarding checklist to attach to the packet (customer success tasks + what we need from Starnexa).

I’ll also review the SOW for any standard clauses they may try to redline (I’ve highlighted Term/Termination and Liability sections for quick review).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Starnexa vendor intake & PO path — procurement readiness

Hi Ellen / Michael / Raj —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Kim’s notes, next steps from our side: 

1) We will send the vendor packet with the redacted SOC 2 link and a short data-flow doc attached. Link: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/SOC2-Redwood-2026-redacted.pdf
2) Attached: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf, redwood_sow_starnexa_v1.docx (draft). These include W-9, insurance summary, onboarding checklist and the SOW for a two-endpoint pilot.
3) Billing entity: Redwood, Inc. (remit: accounts@redwood.ai; EIN 12-3456789). Please confirm if Starnexa needs a different legal entity listed on invoices.
4) Payment terms: Net30 — good to confirm on your side and include PO number when you issue the first invoice.
5) Expected onboarding timeline: once procurement completes vendor setup and issues PO, we estimate 7–14 business days for AP setup + 3 business days for engineering to schedule the pilot environment. Target pilot kickoff of 2026-10-15 looks feasible if PO is issued by ~2026-09-30.

Next asks for Starnexa:
- Michael: please confirm the internal vendor intake steps and whether you need additional docs (e.g., MSSP/pen test reports).
- Ellen/Raj: confirm finance contact for invoice matching and whether there’s a preferred invoice numbering format.

We’ll also route the SOW to DocuSign once legal confirms the final language. DocuSign envelope (sandbox link): https://app.docusign.com/sandbox/ENVELOPEID-XYZ123

If there are no additional security artifacts required beyond SOC 2 and the data-flow summary, I’ll have Kim’s team finalize the packet and send to Michael directly by EOD tomorrow.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to getting the pilot scheduled.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
